title: Central and South America Perils
text:
Central and South America Perils

The following table lists the perils and peril codes that 
Touchstone
 supports for Central and South
 America.

| Import peril code | Peril | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PAL | All licensed perils | |
| PES | Earthquake shake only | |
| PWH | Tropical cyclone only | For this region, the PWH code contains explicit modeling for
 precipitation flood. However, precipitation flood losses are included
 automatically in the Wind losses. |
| PTS | Tsunami | |

Peril support by country

The following table lists the perils and peril codes that 
Touchstone
 supports for each country within the
 Central and South American region:

| Country | Peril codes | Perils |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Belize | PAL PES PWH | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Tropical cyclone only |
| Costa Rica | PAL PES PWH | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Tropical cyclone only |
| El Salvador | PAL PES PWH | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Tropical cyclone only |
| Guatemala | PAL PES PWH | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Tropical cyclone only |
| Honduras | PAL PES PWH | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Tropical cyclone only |
| Nicaragua | PAL PES PWH | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Tropical cyclone only |
| Panama | PAL PES PWH | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Tropical cyclone only |
| Chile | PAL PES PTS | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Tsunami |
| Colombia | PAL PES PTS | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Tsunami |
| Ecuador | PAL PES PTS | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Tsunami |
| Peru | PAL PES PTS | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Tsunami |
| Venezuela | PAL PES PTS | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Tsunami |
